title: Remote HF model-server auth token gates binding but is not enforced at the HTTP request boundary
evidence: The bind guard accepts a non-loopback target when HF_EMBED_ALLOW_REMOTE_BIND and a non-empty HF_EMBED_AUTH_TOKEN are present, but the /api/embed route and request handler never examine the token or Authorization; the client sends only content headers.
recommendation: Enforce a documented request credential and send it from the client, or remove the remote-bind opt-in and fail closed. Add live HTTP tests for missing, wrong and valid credentials.
scopeProof: Read the scoped server, client, README, supervision and IPC perimeter sources; exact search found token use only in the bind guard and no request-side authorization branch.

evidenceRefs: No root checklist.md; authoritative validators intentionally not run

candidate: stale Unix-socket unlink or chmod-through-symlink vulnerability
reason: The shared IPC server verifies ownership, rejects symlinks and chmods only a verified socket; the model-server supervisor applies matching Unix-socket checks.
